## Checklist
- [ ] Reviewed full change and filenames for public disclosure **before push**
- [ ] No user chat, personal identity data, secrets or private-project references
- [ ] Relevant positive, negative and failure/recovery tests
- [ ] Privacy/consent and game-action boundaries preserved
- [ ] Dependency and licensing implications reviewed
- [ ] Documentation/work index updated when material
- [ ] CodeQL + required CI green on **exact latest SHA** (or explicitly pending)
- [ ] No automatic merge, release, installation or live game connection
